cartes.resume: A shop with no IT department and an old website stuck on errors. I pitched the project to the manager, then delivered on my own a showcase site and a secure back office he runs himself.
The black hole on the opening screen is computed in real time: every pixel casts a ray of light whose path is bent by gravity, just like in the film Interstellar.

jalons.texte: RISC option, Saint-Joseph high school. Three years of hardware, networking and virtualization.
Zmobile01 on repairs, Sogetrel twice on fiber optics, Micronov on hardware, Stratus Packaging in the IT department.
Vocational Bac earned with honours. Started the BTS SIO, SLAM option, at Joseph-Marie Carriat high school: the move into development.
Showcase site and secure back office, delivered solo: 5,326 lines, 15 out of 15 acceptance checks.
Looking for a development internship, from January 11 to February 26, 2027.
In the same field, to go further in development.
